subject: reasoning
question: Statements: Some pens are papers. All papers are books. Conclusions: I. Some pens are books. II. All books are pens.
solution:
Statements:

Some pens are papers.

All papers are books.

From the second statement: All papers ⊆ books

From the first statement: Some pens are papers

So those pens which are papers must also be books.

👉 Conclusion I: Some pens are books — follows

👉 Conclusion II: All books are pens — does not follow (because only some pens are papers, not all books)

Hence, only conclusion I follows.
